question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Severe**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Severe**" means very intense or extreme. (बहुत तीव्र या अत्यधिक)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The word is an adjective and can be used to describe various things, such as weather, punishment, or a medical condition.
 
 
• **Example**: *The severe storm caused widespread damage.*
 
 

*​*Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamed **means domesticated or trained. (पालतू या प्रशिक्षित)
 
• **Feral **means wild or untamed. (जंगली या अदम्य)
 
• **Simple **means easy or uncomplicated. (आसान या सरल)
